title: nan
authors: Mateos-Ramirez P.; Gomez-Avila J.; Villaseñor C.; Arana-Daniel N.
key_contribution: Presents a visual odometry method using satellite imagery comparison to reduce accumulated error for fixed-wing UAV navigation in GPS-denied zones, validated in real-world flights.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
